caption: The drawing depicts a patchwork quilt draped over an upholstered armchair. The quilt is made up of irregular, multi-colored fabric pieces in various shades including reds, blues, greens, yellows, creams, and black, all stitched together with visible embroidery in multiple colors and geometric and zigzag patterns. The quilt’s border is predominantly black with sections of bright, patterned patchwork. Beneath the quilt, the armchair is visible and is colored in various brown shades, suggesting a soft, textured fabric. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. In the lower left corner, there are two rectangular insets: one shows a close-up of part of the quilt with detailed stitching and floral embroidery in red, green, white, and blue on pale and dark fabric; the other inset shows a section of the quilt highlighting embroidery and patterned designs in yellow, red, and blue on a tan and black background. The composition focuses primarily on the quilt and chair, with the insets providing additional detail.
title: Crazy Quilt - Patchwork
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
